title: Frequent Itemset Mining and Association Rules
content: Apriori algorithm uses the downward closure property of support to prune the search space of itemsets. FP-Growth builds a compact FP-Tree to avoid candidate generation.

title: Stream Computing with DGIM and Flajolet-Martin
content: DGIM algorithm maintains exponential buckets of power of two sizes to estimate sliding window bit counts. Flajolet-Martin tracks trailing zeros to estimate distinct elements cardinality.

title: Locality-Sensitive Hashing and MinHash
content: MinHash estimates Jaccard similarity between document shingles. LSH bands partition signatures into buckets to efficiently discover near-duplicate candidate pairs.

title: Inverted Index Construction and Compression
content: Inverted index maps dictionary vocabulary terms to posting lists of document IDs. Variable Byte and Elias Gamma codecs compress document gap integers on disk.

title: Probabilistic Relevance Scoring and BM25
content: Okapi BM25 scoring model balances term frequency saturation with document length normalization using k1 and b parameters based on Robertson-Spärck Jones probabilistic IR theory.

title: Link Analysis and PageRank Power Iteration
content: PageRank algorithm models random surfer behavior on directed web graph with teleportation factor d and distributes dangling node authority evenly to ensure convergence.

title: Dense Vector Retrieval and IVF-Flat Indexing
content: Dense retrieval uses neural bi-encoders to map queries and documents into dense embedding spaces. IVF-Flat clusters embeddings with K-Means to speed up multi-probe search.

title: Learning to Rank and Pairwise Neural RankNet
content: Learning to rank models optimize document ranking orders. Pairwise RankNet neural networks minimize cross-entropy loss over document pair score differences.

title: Distributed Big Data Systems: HDFS and MapReduce
content: HDFS stores partitioned block replicas across distributed slave nodes. MapReduce computes map, shuffle, partition, and reduce pipelines with fault-tolerant recovery.

title: Hybrid Search and RAG Generation Pipelines
content: RAG systems combine sparse BM25 keyword matching with dense semantic embeddings via Reciprocal Rank Fusion RRF and cross-encoder re-ranking for grounded text generation.
